wealth_reference_at_signal: max(initial research principal, all decision_equity_usd values through the current signal close); not-yet-recognized dividend claims are excluded under the frozen delayed-recognition research proxy; no external flows
current_budget_base_at_signal: existing Phase 4 decision_equity_usd, which excludes not-yet-recognized dividend claims
comparison: For each existing enhanced ledger row only, compare recorded TQQQ member_budget_usd against decision_equity_usd times the existing smooth_bounded_capital_risk_ratio(wealth_reference). Report the separate reference risk_capital. No change to past targets, fills, NAV, costs or candidate identity.
limits: S4 parameters are reproduced as a descriptive diagnostic, not adopted by the Phase 4 candidate. The covered set M is diagnostic only; applying this curve or changing M would require a separate reviewed research policy. A nonbinding historical overlay cannot establish a counterfactual strategy return or loss guarantee.
